# Rust By Example
# 【1†Associated items】

“Associated Items” refers to a set of rules pertaining to 【2†`item`】s of various types. It is an extension to `trait` generics, and allows `trait`s to internally define new items.

One such item is called an associated type, providing simpler usage patterns when the `trait` is generic over its container type.
